profile.headline: Senior Web Developer at Kaiser Permanente
profile.summary:
I’m a multifaceted technologist and creative professional with over a decade at Kaiser Permanente (since 2014), where I bridge business, technology, and media to deliver effective, engaging digital solutions.

In my role, I wear multiple hats—Business Analyst, Full‑Stack Developer, Web Designer, and Multimedia Specialist—often within the same project. I work closely with customers to understand their needs, translate them into thoughtful designs, and build end‑to‑end solutions that are both functional and visually compelling.

As a developer, I design and build responsive, database‑driven web applications, managing the full lifecycle—from requirements and architecture to hosting and ongoing optimization. 

My technical experience includes:
o Front‑end: HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript
o Back‑end: PHP, SQL
o Database design, creation, and management
o Web hosting and deployment

My foundation in technology began in the early 1990s through both formal education and hands‑on industry experience across multiple organizations, giving me a long‑term perspective on how systems, tools, and user expectations have evolved.

Creativity has always been a parallel passion. I’ve been an avid photographer since the 1980s and expanded into videography over the last decade, blending storytelling with technical execution. I’m highly proficient across Adobe Creative Cloud, including Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Audition. With these tools, I’ve produced:
o Logos, icons, graphics, and animations
o Optimized and edited imagery
o Cinemagraphs, tutorials, and documentary‑style videos

One of the most challenging—and rewarding—areas of my work is live, real‑time, multi‑camera streaming for large‑scale conferences with thousands of global viewers. These high‑stakes productions combine my technical and creative skill sets and involve:
o Interactive websites with chat and messaging
o Video, lighting, and sound production
o Motion graphics and animation
o Live streaming infrastructure and support

They demand careful planning, adaptability under pressure, and calm problem‑solving when things don’t go as planned. I’ve delivered these events with both skeletal crews and larger teams, thriving in fast‑paced, high‑visibility environments.

I’m a graduate of Cal Poly, San Luis Obispo, with a degree in Business Administration – Management Information Systems. Outside of work, I’m passionate about surfing, spending time outdoors, photography and videography, building and optimizing anything hands‑on, Warriors basketball, and most importantly, family and friends.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer & Multimedia
positions.description:
•	UI design of all department websites.
•	Web Development utilizing PHP, HTML, JQUERY, AJAX, Bootstrap,MySQL, CSS, Javascript 
•	Adviser on all technical business projects including partnerships with external venders such as Rosetta Stone or Lee Hecht Harrison.
•	Implementation of analytics code and creation of reports for all department websites.
•	Generation of multimedia needs for the department including videos, photography, graphics, and animation (Adobe: Photoshop, Illustrator, Premier, After Effects)
•	Creation of eLearning tools.
positions.insights: Adobe Premiere Pro, Web Development and +3 skills

positions.title: Lead Front & Back End Web Developer, Application Programmer, Business Analyst
positions.description:
•	Lead programmer for Bio-Rad’s former, global, dynamic website which was utilized by over 300 countries worldwide, translated into 9 languages, and had 940,888 unique visitors in 2011. (HTML, CSS, Javascript, Broadvision, Unix, Webtrends, SQL, CVS, Unix)
•	Lead programmer for the Bioplex Calculator that provides customers worldwide the ability to custom create and order assays and reagents from Bio-Rad.  In 2011 there was 5,723 customers using this tool. (HTML, CSS, Javascript, XML, Java, Broadvision, CVS, Unix)
•	Authored various technical documents supporting corporate change process.  The technical documents include detailed test plans, implementation procedures, roll back procedures, and communications.
•	Analyzed business process’ for various business units (eBus & SAP OCM Training), designed automated solutions to optimize efficiency, and programmed various small software applications to implement the solutions.  (Microsoft Access, SQL, VBA, Excel) 
•	Ancily uPerform System Administrator – responsible for setting up, and configuring the development and production servers as well as administrating content at the user level.
•	Data Analyst of Plateau Learning Management System (LMS) and SAP System.  Conducted continual detailed analysis of systems to ensure integrity.  Analysis required the import of data, from multiple sources, into a relational database and using queries to create exception reports.  (Microsoft Access)
•	SAP training environment administrator – responsible for system and data management to ensure it’s available for ongoing training.   This entails imaging, restores, data loads, proper assignment of training IDs/passwords, and planning transports.
•	Wiki Administrator – installed, configured, and developed pages for training wiki (PHP, HTML, Linux, MySQL)
•	Provided technical support.
•	Within Bio-Rad I have worked within Corporate IT, Life Science Group (LSG) eBusiness, LSG Bioplex, and Corporate SAP Training.

positions.title: Front & Back End Web Developer, Application Programmer, Business Analyst
positions.description:
•	Programmer for the Support Contract Assistant which is a dynamic website that manages support contracts and also upsells support to customers.  (HTML, CSS, Javascript, Broadvision, Oracle, CVS)
•	Lead developer for the Channel Interface Program (Microsoft Access, VB, SQL Server)
•	Drove the re-design, implementation, and training of a nation-wide chemical tracking system. (Delphi Programming / Objective C)
•	Programmed various analysis tools that identified gaps within the HP supply chain. (Visual Basic and Excel VBA)
•	Trainer to both technical and non-technical audiences.
•	Provided technical support for global web applications. 
•	Business Analyst for Corporate Payroll.  Designed and authored many technical specifications responsible for calculating and distributing millions of dollars to 93,000 employees worldwide.
•	Within Hewlett-Packard I have worked within Corporate Payroll, Product Generation Information Systems, and e-Services.
